DeterminationBasis: Existing T03 controls establish authority validity, scope, subject binding, class explicitness, changed-condition reassessment and exception boundaries, but no existing T03 control requires the governing jurisdiction itself to be identifiable where authority depends on jurisdiction. A dedicated jurisdiction-dependent authority control is therefore required.

Existing T03 controls bound authority and scope generally, but no existing T03 control tests the distinct governed act of disclosing protected evidence for verification and requires that disclosure itself remain bounded to the authority and scope of the examination. A dedicated protected-evidence disclosure-boundary control is therefore required.
